activities: bounded AI-assisted internal recommendations and workflow preparation

sector_specific_authorisation.boundary: This classification remains valid only while the services stay within commercial, digital, website and CRM implementation scope and do not enter a regulated profession.

requirements.name: Census registration using Modelo 036
requirements.trigger: Before starting economic activity, performing operations or becoming subject to withholding obligations.
requirements.owner_action: Choose operating form and submit the correct Modelo 036 registration.

requirements.name: Economic activity and IAE classification
requirements.trigger: The activity must be classified even when the operator is exempt from paying IAE.
requirements.owner_action: Confirm the exact activity heading or headings for digital consultancy, CRM implementation, web services and content production.
requirements.payment_note: Natural persons are exempt from IAE payment; qualifying entities below EUR 1,000,000 turnover are also generally exempt.
requirements.official_source: Agencia Tributaria — Impuesto sobre Actividades Económicas

requirements.name: Social Security self-employed registration
requirements.owner_action: Complete RETA registration through Importass if the chosen operating form is self-employed activity.
requirements.official_source: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social — alta de autónomo

requirements.name: Municipal activity, premises or home-office procedure
requirements.trigger: Depends on municipality, premises, public access, signage, works, employees and whether the activity is carried out from a home or office.
requirements.owner_action: Run the Catalonia FUE guided procedure for the actual municipality and operating address before opening premises or receiving clients there.
requirements.official_source: Generalitat de Catalunya — FUE and Canal Empresa

requirements.name: Online service-provider identification and e-commerce disclosures
requirements.trigger: A commercial website or electronic contracting flow is made public.
requirements.owner_action: Publish the operator identity, address, direct contact details, registration information where applicable, prices and contracting information required by the LSSI.
requirements.official_source: BOE — Ley 34/2002, article 10 and electronic contracting provisions

requirements.name: Prospect and client data controller controls
requirements.trigger: The venture collects names, emails, telephone numbers, professional details or other personal data for its own purposes.
requirements.owner_action: Complete lawful basis, layered information, RAT, retention, rights, security and breach procedures.

requirements.name: Client CRM processor agreement
requirements.trigger: The service accesses or configures a client's CRM containing personal data under the client's instructions.
requirements.owner_action: Execute an Article 28 processor agreement, define subprocessors, instructions, security, deletion or return and assistance duties.
requirements.official_source: AEPD — responsable y encargado del tratamiento

requirements.name: Consumer contracting controls
requirements.trigger: A natural person contracts outside their trade or profession.
requirements.owner_action: Provide pre-contract information, written budget where required, price and payment information, withdrawal information and complaint handling.
requirements.official_source: Agència Catalana del Consum and Spanish consumer rules

requirements.name: Catalonia official complaint forms and notice
requirements.trigger: Goods or services are supplied directly or through intermediaries to consumers in Catalonia.
requirements.owner_action: Obtain official complaint forms, provide the required channel and display the applicable notice.
requirements.official_source: Agència Catalana del Consum — fulls oficials de queixa, reclamació i denúncia

requirements.name: EU AI Act role and transparency classification
requirements.trigger: AI systems are used professionally, offered under the venture name or interact directly with natural persons.
requirements.owner_action: Maintain AI literacy, classify provider versus deployer roles, retain human oversight and provide any required interaction or generated-content disclosure from 2 August 2026.
requirements.official_source: European Commission — AI Act and Article 50 transparency guidance

requirements.name: EU cross-border operator registration
requirements.trigger: The venture supplies or receives qualifying services across EU borders where ROI or VIES treatment applies.
requirements.owner_action: Confirm VAT place-of-supply treatment and request ROI registration through Modelo 036 when required.

requirements.name: Professional indemnity and cyber insurance
requirements.trigger: Before handling material client data, integrations or commercial reliance.
requirements.owner_action: Obtain quotes and define coverage after the operating form and service limits are confirmed.

current_decision.reason: The site may be staged synthetically, but business registrations and frozen professional reviews are not completed.
